{{Quote|Destroyed the last copy of the Epistle of Marka Ragnos&hellip; Retrieved Jori Daragon's amulet ''and'' the Eye of Horak-mul&hellip; Amazing!|Feln, on Celeste Morne's assignments|<ref name="KotOR25" />}}
'''Jori Daragon's amulet''' was an [[Sith talisman/Legends|Sith amulet]] created in the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] at some point by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]]. Shaped like an ornamental [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]], it had a connection to another similar [[Gav Daragon's Sith amulet|amulet]]. When the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and [[Jori Daragon]] arrived in the empire from [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] in 5000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]], the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] planned to use the [[Prisoner/Legends|imprisoned]] siblings in his plot to expand the empire through conquest of the Republic. Keeping the Daragons separated from each other, Sadow allowed Gav, whom he had been [[Sith training|training]] in the use of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]], to record an inspirational message for Jori on his amulet's counterpart, which the Dark Lord then delivered to Jori. After she had viewed the message, Sadow further returned to Jori the Daragons' impounded [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Starbreaker 12]]''. Sadow's manipulations eventually led to Jori being forced to depart for the Republic without Gav, with the amulet serving her as a reminder of her [[Gender/Legends|brother]].

After arriving in the Republic's [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]], Daragon eventually managed to reach the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Emperor/Legends|empress]], [[Teta/Legends|Teta]], and warn her and a pair of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] who were present of the danger posed by the Sith Empire, showing the amulet as physical evidence of her account. Soon thereafter, the empire indeed launched an [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|invasion]] of the Republic, during which Gav, who had been appointed the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the [[Sith invasion fleet|Sith fleet]], used the coupling between the two amulets in an attempt to find Jori on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]]. Upon experiencing remorse over his affiliation with Sadow, however, Gav then traveled to the [[Primus Goluud system]] to confront the Dark Lord, but Sadow trapped him in a crippled ship and [[Supernova (Sith magic)|caused]] a nearby [[Primus Goluud/Legends|star]] to undergo a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]]. At that point, Jori, who had followed Gav, once again found herself peering at her amulet as she was forced to abandon her brother to his [[Death/Legends|death]]. More than a [[3963 BBY|millennium]] later, the [[Jedi Covenant]] [[Covenant Shadow|Shadow]] [[Celeste Morne]] retrieved Daragon's amulet on one of her assignments for the Covenant.

==Description==
{{Quote|How do I&mdash;''oh''!|Jori Daragon, attempting to access Gav Daragon's message stored on the amulet|<ref name="TGAotS4" />}}
[[File:JoriDaragonAmuletAccess-TGAotS4.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Jori Daragon accesses a message stored on the amulet.]]
[[Jori Daragon]]'s [[Sith talisman/Legends|amulet]]<ref name="KotOR25" /> was one of a pair of coupled [[Sith artifact/Legends|amulets]]<ref name="TFotSE3">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 3|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 3]]</ref> created by the [[Sith (species)/Legends|Sith]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]]<ref name="TFotSE2" /> at some point by [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]].<ref name="5000 BBY" /> [[Limb/Legends|Palm]]-sized and shaped like a type of [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]] worn by the empire's [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]], the amulet was made of [[Color/Legends|silver]]-colored metal and had an inlaid yellow [[Gemstone/Legends|gemstone]].<ref name="TGAotS4" /> It also had smaller yellow incrustations<ref name="TGAotS5">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 5|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 5]]</ref> and was adorned with chains.<ref name="TGAotS4" /> Like its [[Gav Daragon's Sith amulet|counterpart]],<ref name="TFotSE3" /> the amulet of Jori Daragon had three straps for securing it to the wielder's hand.<ref name="TGAotS4" />

The amulet could be used by a practitioner of [[Sith sorcery/Legends|Sith magic]] to record a spoken message along with a palm-sized, golden, three-dimensional depiction of the sender.<ref name="TGAotS4" /> In addition, according to Daragon, Sith Lords utilized amulets such as hers in order to focus their [[Magic/Legends|magic]] powers, although Daragon herself was not certain of the specifics of such use.<ref name="TFotSE2" /> Beside the artifact's active applications, its presence also caused a tingling sensation emanating from the amulet that was connected to it.<ref name="TFotSE3" />

==History==
===In the Sith Empire===
{{Quote|&hellip;he gave me this amulet&hellip; the Sith Lords use it for focusing their powers, somehow&hellip;|Jori Daragon, on her brother Gav|<ref name="TFotSE2" />}}
When, in 5000 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="5000 BBY" /> the [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] [[Gav Daragon|Gav]] and Jori Daragon arrived in the Sith Empire as a result of a random [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump from the distant [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] and were promptly [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] on the orders of the empire's suspicious Sith Lords,<ref name="TGAotS2">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 2]]</ref> the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Naga Sadow/Legends|Naga Sadow]] sought to use the situation to realize his ambitions of expanding the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] realm through conquest. [[First raid on the Sith Citadel|Breaking out]] the two [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], Sadow separated them, keeping Jori at [[Naga Sadow's Khar Delba citadel|his citadel]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Khar Delba]] while Gav was being [[Sith training|instructed]] in the use of Sith magic at a [[Naga Sadow's Khar Shian citadel|fortress]] Sadow kept on the world's [[Moon/Legends|moon]], [[Khar Shian]].<ref name="TGAotS4" />

[[File:JoriGavAmuletMessage-TGAotS4.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Gav Daragon used the amulet to send a message to his sister, Jori.]]
At the latter site, Gav, who had been practicing in the use of a Sith amulet, recorded a message on its counterpart for Jori in which he briefly mentioned his training. He also informed his [[Gender/Legends|sister]] that Sadow had made "arrangements" that would allow both of them to return to the Republic and expressed his belief that they would be reunited soon. Sadow subsequently delivered the linked amulet to Jori on Khar Delba. Although the explorer was initially perplexed regarding how her brother's message could be acccessed, it presented itself shortly thereafter. Expressing gratitude to Sadow for delivering the message,<ref name="TGAotS4" /> Daragon held on to the amulet<ref name="TGAotS5" /> as the Dark Lord brought her to her and Gav's [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Starbreaker 12]]'', which Sadow had also [[Second raid on the Sith Citadel|liberated]] from Sith impoundment.<ref name="TGAotS4" />

Having been manipulated by Sadow, his rival, [[Ludo Kressh]], at that point [[Battle of Khar Delba|attacked]] the Khar Delba [[Fortress/Legends|citadel]].<ref name="TGAotS4" /> Seizing the opportunity, Sadow urged Daragon to board the ''Starbreaker 12'' and depart for the Republic without her brother, although before the explorer ultimately complied, she gazed at the amulet in her hand, with tears welling in her [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] at the thought of abandoning Gav alone in the Sith Empire.<ref name="TGAotS5" />

===In the Galactic Republic===
{{Quote|The amulet&hellip; tingling&hellip; Jori has its counterpart&hellip; Maybe it'll help me find her down there&hellip; in all that wreckage&hellip;|Gav Daragon|<ref name="TFotSE3" />}}
When she arrived in the [[Empress Teta system/Legends|Koros system]], Daragon was promptly arrested for her prior misdeeds<ref name="TFotSE1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 2]]</ref> and sentenced to labor on the [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] world [[Ronika/Legends|Ronika]]. Dedicated to rescue her brother and warn the Republic of the threat posed by the Sith Empire, however, Daragon soon escaped and returned to the planet [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]], where she broke into the [[Empress Teta's palace|palace]] of the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] [[Emperor/Legends|empress]], [[Teta/Legends|Teta]]. As both the empress and her guards surrounded Daragon with drawn [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]], the young woman attempted to convince Teta to listen to her warnings. She also displayed the amulet, holding it up as physical proof of her tale. Teta and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Memit Nadill]] and [[Odan-Urr/Legends|Odan-Urr]] were then persuaded of the truthfulness of Daragon's account,<ref name="TFotSE2" /> and indeed soon thereafter a [[Sith invasion fleet|Sith fleet]] that had followed the [[Daragon Trail|hyperspace route]] taken by the ''Starbreaker 12'' launched an [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|invasion]] of the Republic, including an [[Battle of Koros Major (Great Hyperspace War)|attack]] on Koros Major.<ref name="TFotSE3" />

[[File:DaragonLeavesPrimusGoluud-TFotSE4.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Jori Daragon looking at her amulet as she is forced to leave Gav Daragon to perish]]
During that battle, Gav, whom Sadow had appointed the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Sith [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], attempted to find Jori. With his amulet reacting to the presence of that of his sister, Gav arrived at [[Aarrba's Repair Dock]], where Jori was also headed in order to obtain a ship to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in combat. At the facility, one of Gav's [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] its owner, [[Aarrba]]. The devastated commander,<ref name="TFotSE3" /> remorseful over his involvement in Sadow's schemes, then traveled to the [[Primus Goluud system]] in order to confront the Dark Lord.<ref name="TFotSE4">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire'' 4]]</ref>

Sadow, however, trapped his former [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] aboard a damaged [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] and, when both a [[Jori Daragon's armed courier|ship]] piloted by Jori and Teta's fleet also arrived in the system in pursuit of Gav, [[Supernova (Sith magic)|triggered]] the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Primus Goluud/Legends|Primus Goluud]] into undergoing a [[Supernova/Legends|supernova]] explosion. Gav, realizing what Sadow had done, warned Jori and the Koros fleet of the impending disaster which he himself was unable to evade. Preparing to jump her vessel into hyperspace, Jori then once again peered at her amulet while contemplating her guilt over leaving her brother to his doom.<ref name="TFotSE4" />

After the Republic eventually emerged victorious over the Sith Empire, Jori became the new owner of Aarrba's Repair Dock.<ref name="TFotSE4" /> At some point by [[3963 BBY]], the [[Jedi Covenant]]'s [[Covenant Shadow|Shadow]] [[Celeste Morne]] recovered Daragon's amulet for the organization, with the accomplishment being recorded in a [[Covenant Shadow Database|database]] the Covenant kept on its Shadows. When the Covenant member [[Feln]] viewed Morne's record that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="KotOR25" /> he<ref name="CSWE Feln">{{CSWECite|I|261|Feln, Jedi Master}}</ref> was highly impressed with her past assignments, including the retrieval of the amulet.<ref name="KotOR25" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TalesOfTheJedi-TheGoldenAgeOfTheSith4.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Jori Daragon's amulet first appeared in ''Tales of the Jedi &ndash; The Golden Age of the Sith'' 4.]]
Jori Daragon's amulet first appeared in the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 4|fourth issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] mini-series. The issue was written by [[Kevin J. Anderson]], penciled by [[Dario Carrasco, Jr.]],<ref name="TGAotS4" /> and published on [[January 8]], [[1997]].<ref name="TGAotS4 Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54593/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996_4|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996) #4}}</ref> The amulet was first identified by name in the [[Knights of the Old Republic 25|twenth-fifth issue]] of Dark Horse Comics' [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'']] comic series, which was written by [[John Jackson Miller]]<ref name="KotOR25" /> and published on [[January 30]], [[2008]].<ref name="KotOR25 Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54344/star_wars_knights_of_the_old_republic_2006_25|text=Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (2006) #25}}</ref>

The fourth<ref name="TGAotS4" /> and the [[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 5|fifth issue]]<ref name="TGAotS5" />&mdash;published on [[February 12]], 1997<ref name="TGAotS5 Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54594/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_golden_age_of_the_sith_1996_5|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Golden Age of the Sith (1996) #5}}</ref>&mdash;of ''The Golden Age of the Sith'', both of which were colored by [[Perry McNamee]], depicted Jori Daragon's amulet as being silver in color and encrusted with a yellow gem.<ref name="TGAotS4" /><ref name="TGAotS5" /> In contrast, in<ref name="TFotSE2" /> the [[July 23]], 1997<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54583/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_fall_of_the_sith_empire_1997_2|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Fall of the Sith Empire (1997) #2}}</ref> [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 2|second]]<ref name="TFotSE2" /> and<ref name="TFotSE4" /> the [[September 17]], 1997<ref name="TFotSE4 Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54585/star_wars_tales_of_the_jedi_-_the_fall_of_the_sith_empire_1997_4|text=Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi - The Fall of the Sith Empire (1997) #4}}</ref> [[Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire 4|fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Fall of the Sith Empire]]'' series, colorist [[Ray Murtaugh]] depicted the artifact in multiple shades of blue. This article assumes the color scheme from ''The Golden Age of the Sith'' is correct.<ref name="TFotSE4" />
